title: Excellent recipe organization system!
body: This app is the epitome of convenience!!! Importing multiple recipes at the same time via a list of URLs is such a time-saver! And I especially appreciate the multilingual support. The app can import from English websites just as easily as Japanese!! (And the text looks great in both languages!) The ability to customize any recipe, anytime, provides so much control! From adjustments for personal preference (e.g. reducing the amount of sugar in the ingredients list) to updating the default recipe image with a photo of my own completed dish—even a mere spelling error. Multiple shopping lists allow for better organization as well. For example, I can add ingredients for recipes I’m making tomorrow to a “buy now” list and recipes for a planned future event to a different list! The reason for 4/5 stars is because, although the app is aesthetic and easy to use, I believe there is room for improvement. Here are some suggestions for increased convenience that I’ve thought up while importing 300+ recipes (both from the web and manually): • Add a search function for collections. I categorize recipes quite extensively and a search would be quicker than scrolling! • Allow ingredients and steps to be rearranged when editing a recipe. Right now, to add an extra ingredient in the middle of the list or split up a long step in the instructions, the only new text-box available is at the bottom, and you can’t drag it up to the needed spot. It’s quite a pain to copy-paste/delete the existing text in order to get things in the right places! • Link the recipe titles in the shopping list. If the list is arranged by “recipe,” you can see the title, but must manually navigate to it yourself (which is less than expedient). • Notify if the URL limit is reached before clicking “save” when importing multiple recipes from the web. A countdown or something would be greatly appreciated (rather than my oft incorrect mental tally). Overall, I love the convenience of this app for the myriad of ways I can organize and customize all my recipes! Thank you and keep up the good work!!

title: Way Better Than Expected
body: I have tried SO many different recipe collection apps, starting with the OG, Pinterest, but I have never been able to find one that has all the features I need and WORKS! I can’t tell you how many others I tried (even paid for) and then promptly deleted because they didn’t do what I needed or were too slow or just didn’t work. I didn’t have high hopes for this one either but I was SO pleasantly surprised. I did have to go one-by-one through all my saved Tiktoks in my recipes Collection but the transfer was very quick! I’d say about 80% of the TikToks transferred over perfectly - accurate ingredients, instructions, notes and picture. Any of the ones that didn’t transfer over, I just gave ChatGPT the content creator’s name and asked it to help me figure out so-and-so’s recipe, and I used the app’s “paste text” feature, then I could use a screenshot from the video and save the link. Again, it worked perfectly. I love that I could set up all the collections I needed (ex. Beef, chicken, tofu, soup, salad, cocktails, etc) - but the best part is that I can tag a single recipe to multiple collections (ex. Chicken + Soup), which now allows me to create more collections for methods (slow cooker, air fryer, Instant Pot, etc). I’m now able to search and find exactly what I need!!! I’ve tried out the AI recipe creator a few times and it’s not perfect but get’s me about 90% there and I can adjust. What else… there are so many other features that I haven’t even tried yet, like the list-maker, but so far I am SO impressed. THANK YOU!

body: I’ve been getting super into juicing and home made low carb dinners and this makes it sooo easy to actually follow up on the recipes I save. I’ve made so many different juices this week alone I’m super excited!!! Absolutely love this app.

title: App improvement
body: When making your collections, make the app pull the recipe out of the recipe section completely. It makes it’s easier to sort through when building collections.

title: Excellent
body: This does everything I want it to do. Save and organize recipes, create shopping lists, zero adds, totally sensible from an end user standpoint. Bravo!

title: I am very impressed
body: Using my 5 freebies to test the app and it’s quite impressive. Many apps will tell you it’s illegible, especially with a photo recipe, but this app’s AI can pick it up almost to perfection. The nutrition facts available is what really reeled me in too. Been waiting a long time for a do-it-all recipe-saving app like this!

title: Easy and great functionally
body: Found this on Reddit after my previous recipe app abruptly went away. So far I love Flavorish. I prior functionality from Instagram works beautifully. Importing from websites is a breeze, I also love the comprehensive and clear release notes to stay updated.

title: great option for recipe importing
body: It works really well, I would rather trade ads rather than a paid thing though, But it works well and the creator works hard. Great UI.

title: Outstanding App to create new recipes
body: Creative and easy to use! Tastes great… you can customize your own ideas into it as you build the parameters or just let the AI build it for you and surprise you with a new dish you haven’t tried before! What a great idea to allow you to try new recipes from your own kitchen!
